project_type: Python robotics platform — MuJoCo simulation + PyTorch ML, CLI-driven
build_command: pip install -e '.[dev,ml]' (already installed in dev environment)
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 -m pytest tests/ -v and confirm 117+ tests pass, 0 failures. 2. Run python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_learned_policy.py -v to verify learned policy tests specifically.
environment_constraints: All commands run via WSL: use 'wsl -e bash -c "cd /root/forge && <cmd>"'. PyTorch is already installed. forge_core/ must have ZERO ROS imports. Use Linux paths /root/forge/... inside commands.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: from __future__ import annotations, logging.getLogger(__name__), dataclass usage, type hints, PROJECT_ROOT from forge_core.config.
key_patterns: Policy ABC: reset(sim)/act(sim)->np.ndarray/done/name. Config loading via forge_core.config.load_yaml(path). YAML-driven configs in config/ and tasks/. Scripts in scripts/ with argparse. Tests in tests/unit/ organized by test class per feature. Lazy import of learned policy in create_policy to avoid torch dependency.
directory_structure: forge/ — project root. forge_core/ — core library (no ROS). scripts/ — CLI tools (forge_eval.py, forge_train.py, etc.). tests/unit/ — pytest unit tests. config/ — YAML configs. docs/ — architecture.md + setup.md. simulation/scenarios/ — MuJoCo scene YAML. tasks/ — task YAML definitions. runs/ — recorded run outputs. models/ — saved model .pt files (created on demand).
